g.text: DuPage-first screen | Measurement qualification precedes target choice
Poly-A RNA-seq is not a mature-small-RNA assay. Coding-only selection yields 32 displayed genes.
Tracks overlap; top 10 per signed track is a reading budget, not a significance or effect threshold.
